headline: Strictly 🕺 NEW 🆕 Hosts 👥 SPILL 🍵 on Their OPEN 💼 ROLES 🚫
text:
JOHANNES 🕺 RADEBE 🕺 and his new co-hosts 👥 JOSH 🧔 WIDDICOMBE 🧔 plus EMMA 👠 WILLIS 👠 just hit 📻 the podcast 🎙️ to explain their Strictly 🕺 Come 🕺 Dancing 🪩 roles are totally OPEN 📖 and not fixed 🔒 at all as they step in to replace Tess 👠 Daly 👠 and Claudia 👠 Winkleman 👠 who both bounced 🚪 after the 2025 series 📺!! No one's REPLACING 🔄 anybody they stressed 😤 with Willis telling Richard Osman 🧠 on The Rest is Entertainment 🎤 that at the minute it's all very kind of open 📬 and flexible 🧘 like nobody's locked 🔐 into old spots!! "We're gonna be like TOTAL ⚽ FOOTBALL ⚽" Widdicombe added meaning they will be MOVING 🏃 everywhere taking any role needed while Radebe 🕺 said he'll definitely do a little bit of PRYING 🔎 and finding out the TRUTH 🕵️ since he already knows everyone from being a pro dancer 🩰 on the show!!

They straight up SCOTCHED 🚫 those reports 📰 of Radebe having some roving reporter 📡 gig backstage with Willis shutting it down hard saying there's DEFINITELY ❌ no backstage roving reporter which is what has been reported quite a bit 📢!! The whole plan to throw these three together was a total WILD 🃏 CARD decision by producers that took them all by SURPRISE 😲 after a chemistry test 🧪 to see how they vibe as a group!! Willis described the hiring process as the most CLOAK 🧥 AND 🗡️ DAGGER thing she has ever seen taking about four months total and that the chemistry test was terrifying 😱 but so brilliant 🌟 while Widdicombe had to lie to his taxi driver 🚕 claiming he was testing for a show called The Great Garden Glow Up 🌱 if anyone asked!!

Radebe admitted he'll struggle a bit being impartial now he's not competing anymore and joked he's WAITING ⏳ for that judges debrief where he might finally clap back at any overly critical scores from Shirley 🧓 Ballas or the rest of the panel!! He called his new role very very EXCITING 🎉 although he felt a little tinge of FOMO 😔 seeing the pros rehearse without him!! The trio will be hosting the new series starting Saturday 19 September with 15 celebrities including Delta Goodrem 🎤 Shaun Wright-Phillips ⚽ Lacey Turner 🎭 and more all battling for that glitterball 🏆 trophy while judges like Craig Revel Horwood 👨‍⚖️ Motsi Mabuse 💃 and Anton Du Beke return!!

Emma Willis explained the producers said this is the last audition and it's such a wild card they don't even have a script for you so we're gonna sit down get it up on the screen and have a little tinker all together tinkering with the format like mad scientists 🧪!! Widdicombe realized it's difficult when you're paired with two of the most striking people on television looking like the competition winner 🏅 himself next to them which had everyone cracking up 😂 on the podcast!! They all stressed no fixed roles meaning the three of them will be floating around the dancefloor 🕺 the Clauditorium area and everywhere in between like a flexible squad ready to handle intros judge chats and prying for backstage tea ☕!!

The whole switch up came after Daly hosted on the dancefloor introducing dancers and judges while Winkleman ran the upstairs debriefs but now it's all open with these three bringing fresh energy!! Radebe has the advantage of knowing everyone really well already from his pro days so expect some serious insider prying and truth finding that could get spicy 🌶️ during the competition!! Producers went full cloak and dagger for months keeping it secret until the chemistry test sealed the deal making this trio hosting gig a total surprise wild card that has fans buzzing already for the September return!!
